cosmokv-sql — interactive shell for CosmoKv databases

USAGE
  cosmokv-sql                                    # REPL on a transient DB
  cosmokv-sql [--format=FMT] <database>          # REPL on <database>
  cosmokv-sql [--format=FMT] <database> [sql]    # one-shot SQL
  cosmokv-sql [--format=FMT] <database> -        # read SQL from stdin
  cosmokv-sql --help

ARGS
  <database>    Path to a CosmoKv data directory (e.g. ./db) — the
                directory is created if missing, sqlite3-style.
                Optional: with no <database>, the REPL opens a
                transient temp directory that's removed on exit.
  sql           SQL to execute once; without it, drops into REPL.

OPTIONS
  --format=FMT  Output: table (default) | csv | tsv | json
  --help        This help.

REPL DOT-COMMANDS
  .help                  Show dot-command help
  .open FILENAME         Reopen on a persistent database
  .databases             Show the current data source
  .tables                List user tables
  .schema [TABLE]        CREATE TABLE script (all tables if omitted)
  .indexes [TABLE]       List indexes (all if omitted)
  .dump                  Schema + INSERTs for the entire database
  .format FMT            Switch output format mid-session
  .quit / .exit / Ctrl-D Leave the shell
